[Narrator]

Утром кафе выглядит точно так же, как вчера. Только стол у окна свободен.

[Narrator]

Пасифика занимает его в 10:24. Рюкзак ставит на соседний стул, Дневник оставляет внутри.

[Narrator]

В 10:29 она в третий раз расправляет бумажную салфетку.

[Pacifica]

Я не жду. Просто мы договорились на половину.

[Narrator]

Никто не спрашивал. Она проверяет часы ещё раз.

[sfx bell]

[Narrator]

Когда минутная стрелка сдвигается, над дверью звякает колокольчик.

[Gideon]

Здесь свободно или салфетка тоже расследует?

[expression Pacifica annoyed transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Ровно половина. Удивительно, ты умеешь.

[expression Gideon idle transition .18]

[Gideon]

Нашёл часы. Очень сложная технология.

[Narrator]

Он снимает с занятого стула рюкзак и ставит его к ножке стола.

[Pacifica]

Вчера эта технология опоздала на семнадцать минут.

[Gideon]

Сегодня исправилась. Горячий шоколад, пожалуйста.

[Pacifica]

Ты опять будешь пить его полчаса?

[Gideon]

Если ты опять принесла лекцию, надо чем-то занять руки.

[Narrator]

Пасифика вынимает Дневник №3. Кладёт на стол, но пока не открывает.

[Pacifica]

Сегодня без лекции. У нас пропали животные, есть следы и сломанный забор.

[Gideon]

И ошейник. Очень важный участник вчерашней прогулки.

[Pacifica]

И ошейник. С которого мы не должны сразу делать вывод о хозяине следов.

[Narrator]

Гидеон поднимает глаза от меню. Пасифика замечает это и хмурится.

[Pacifica]

Что? Я слушала, когда ты говорил.

[Gideon]

Проверяю, не вернулись ли мы в другое кафе.

[Narrator]

Она двигает меню подальше от Дневника, освобождая место для своих записей.

[when monster Wendigo][Pacifica]Хватит искать подтверждение вендиго. Сначала посмотрим, что там есть на самом деле.

[when monster Werewolf][Pacifica]Хватит искать подтверждение оборотня. Сначала посмотрим, что там есть на самом деле.

[when monster Vampire][Pacifica]Хватит искать подтверждение вампира. Сначала посмотрим, что там есть на самом деле.

[Gideon]

Нормальный план. Даже нечего испортить замечанием.

[Pacifica]

Ещё правило. Если я слишком быстро решаю, кто виноват, скажи прямо.

[Gideon]

Вчера вроде говорил.

[Pacifica]

Сегодня скажи до того, как я начну спорить.

[Gideon]

Надо будет очень быстро.

[Narrator]

Она отмечает на салфетке забор и старую дорогу. Между ними оставляет пустое место вместо большого страшного силуэта.

[Pacifica]

Тут пока вопрос. Пусть побудет вопросом.

[Pacifica]

Ты уже почти справился.

[sfx ch2_cup]

[Narrator]

Перед ним появляется чашка. Он придерживает блюдце, чтобы оно не задело книгу.

[Narrator]

На секунду остаются только звон посуды и чужой разговор у стойки.

[camera zoom 1.035 duration 1]

[music conversation_1 volume .3 fade .5]

[expression Pacifica curious transition .18]

[Pacifica]

А ещё было синее свечение. Ты тоже его видел.

[Gideon]

Видел.

[Pacifica]

Уилл появляется рядом, а мы даже не знаем, зачем он там стоит.

[expression Gideon uncomfortable transition .18]

[Gideon]

Мне это тоже не нравится.

[Narrator]

Он отвечает сразу. Пасифика, уже приготовившая возражение, закрывает рот.

[Gideon]

Но он спас мне жизнь. Это тоже не вычеркнешь из записи.

[Pacifica]

Я не вычёркиваю. Просто помощь не объясняет всё остальное.

[Gideon]

Поэтому и не сказал, что всё объясняет.

[Narrator]

Пасифика проводит пальцем по потёртому углу обложки. Разговор становится тише.

[Pacifica]

Если он снова появится, не пойдёшь за ним один.

[Gideon]

Сначала пусть появится. Я пока никуда не подписывался.

[Narrator]

Она смотрит на него ещё секунду, затем переворачивает лист с заметками.

[expression Pacifica idle transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Ладно. Сначала животные. Тут хотя бы понятно, кого ищут их хозяева.

[Gideon]

Их. Не синее свечение.

[Pacifica]

Я поняла.

[Narrator]

Когда они выходят, шоколад уже допит. Салфетка остаётся лежать ровно.

[Narrator]

За последними домами шоссе уступает место старой лесной дороге. По обочинам ещё держится утренняя сырость.

[Narrator]

Пасифика поправляет лямку небольшого рюкзака. При каждом шаге внутри негромко стукается бутылка.

[Gideon]

Теперь у нашего плана есть багаж.

[Pacifica]

Вода. Фонарик. И место для Дневника, чтобы не носить его под мышкой.

[Gideon]

Ни одной древней проклятой вещи?

[Pacifica]

Бутылка из кухни. Если и проклята, то очень незаметно.

[Narrator]

Она не достаёт фонарик на свету. Только проверяет застёжку и первой сворачивает к повреждённому забору.

[Narrator]

Отсюда вчерашняя тропинка кажется короче. Без ожидания нападения кусты занимают обычное количество места.

[Pacifica]

Смотри под ноги. Вчера мы прошли прямо по краю.

[Gideon]

Ты прошла. Я пытался не наступать тебе на пятки.

[Narrator]

Она уже собирается ответить, но останавливается перед размокшим участком земли.

[Narrator]

В большой вмятине лежит иголка сосны. Вода собралась вдоль неровного края.

[Narrator]

Она ставит носок ботинка рядом, оставляя промежуток. Отпечаток заметно больше, но сама вмятина не особенно глубокая.

[Pacifica]

Если оно большое, почему не продавило сильнее?

[Gideon]

Земля могла быть суше. Или оно легче, чем выглядит.

[Narrator]

Пасифика записывает оба объяснения. Рядом не ставит галочку ни у одного.

[Pacifica]

Такие же, как вчера. Вот ещё один, возле корня.

[Narrator]

Она приседает, не касаясь следа. Гидеон обходит её по сухой стороне.

[Gideon]

И вот эти.

[camera zoom 1.035 duration .8]

[Narrator]

Между двумя крупными отпечатками тянется ряд гораздо меньших. Они почти исчезают в примятой траве.

[Pacifica]

Собачьи?

[Gideon]

Может быть. Только не решай по размеру.

[Narrator]

Пасифика прослеживает ряд взглядом. Малые следы уходят за куст, большие огибают его с другой стороны.

[Pacifica]

Оно могло менять походку.

[Gideon]

И количество земли между ногами.

[Narrator]

Она смотрит ещё раз. Два ряда продолжаются дальше и не превращаются друг в друга.

[expression Pacifica idle transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Ладно. Два разных следа. Возможно, два разных существа.

[Gideon]

Уже лучше, чем одно, которое для удобства уменьшается.

[Narrator]

Вчера ей хотелось сразу назвать находку. Сегодня она сначала открывает страницу для записи.

[Narrator]

У куста поперёк следов лежит тонкая веточка. Поднимать её неудобно, и Пасифика аккуратно переносит ногу через неё.

[Gideon]

Очень важный вопрос. Палка сегодня тоже идёт с нами?

[Pacifica]

Нет. Я могу найти новую.

[Narrator]

Гидеон смотрит на неё. Пасифика выдерживает взгляд одну секунду.

[Gideon]

Прогресс закончился.

[Pacifica]

Это была шутка. Твоя очередь понять.

[Pacifica]

Большой след идёт к старым деревьям. Маленький пока теряется.

[Gideon]

Теряется для нас. Самому следу, кажется, нормально.

[Narrator]

Пасифика сдерживает улыбку и показывает на три места: полосу грязи, открытую книгу и траву вокруг.

[Pacifica]

Тогда проверим внимательнее. Не всё сразу, а то опять затопчем.

[Gideon]

Редкий случай, когда меньше ходить — часть расследования.

[Choice trail_focus LargeTracks]

[Narrator]

Пасифика выбирает сухую полосу рядом с крупными отпечатками. Гидеон идёт на шаг позади и смотрит в стороны.

[Pacifica]

Здесь оно задело дерево. Видишь свежий скол?

[Narrator]

В трещине коры застряло светлое грубое волокно. Оно гораздо жёстче собачьего пуха.

[Gideon]

Вижу. Руками пока не трогай.

[Pacifica]

Я собиралась показать, а не попробовать.

[Narrator]

Она сравнивает его с корой, затем делает маленький рисунок в своих заметках.

[Pacifica]

Светлый, жёсткий. Мог остаться от того, кто прошёл тут.

[Gideon]

Мог. Пока это всё, что он нам сообщил.

[Narrator]

Дальше большие следы становятся мельче на твёрдой земле. За деревьями проступает тёмный прямоугольник крыши.

[Pacifica]

Домик. Если там кто-то есть, сначала посмотрим.

[Gideon]

Запомню, что ты сказала «сначала».

[next chapter_2/watch_hut]
textes/russian/chapter_2/trail_journal:
[Choice trail_focus Journal]

[Narrator]

Пасифика открывает Дневник на сгибе, который уже сам находит нужную страницу.

[when monster Wendigo][Narrator]В рисунке вендиго вес будто уходит вперёд, к вытянутым пальцам. Здесь земля глубже продавлена сзади.

[when monster Werewolf][Narrator]На рисунке оборотня лапа оставляет другой наклон вмятины. Настоящий след сильнее продавлен сзади.

[when monster Vampire][Narrator]У записи о вампире человеческая стопа. Но глубина большого следа распределена совсем иначе.

[Pacifica]

Размер похож. Распределение веса — нет.

[Gideon]

Хорошо, что мы взяли с собой страницу, а не приговор.

[Pacifica]

Я и вчера сказала, что нужно проверить.

[Gideon]

А сегодня проверяем. Это полезная часть.

[Narrator]

Она поворачивает книгу к свету. Несколько штрихов могли обозначать форму, а могли быть тенью художника.

[Pacifica]

Не будем дорисовывать за него то, чего здесь нет.

[Narrator]

Пасифика записывает различие, прежде чем закрыть Дневник. Следы тем временем уходят к старой крыше за деревьями.

[Gideon]

Книга нашла домик?

[Pacifica]

Глаза нашли. Пойдём.

[next chapter_2/watch_hut]
textes/russian/chapter_2/trail_perimeter:
[Choice trail_focus Perimeter]

[Narrator]

Пасифика отступает от грязной полосы и осторожно раздвигает высокую траву сбоку.

[Pacifica]

Если маленькие следы пропали здесь, они должны где-то появиться.

[Gideon]

Или их хозяин научился летать. Сегодня хотелось бы без этого.

[Narrator]

За кустом обнаруживается узкая дуга отпечатков. Она обходит место, где глубоко продавлена земля.

[Pacifica]

Смотри. Маленькие не идут поверх больших.

[Gideon]

Обходят. И здесь тоже.

[Narrator]

Они находят второй такой изгиб. Два ряда сближаются, но не соединяются в одну цепочку.

[Pacifica]

Значит, мы не можем просто сказать, что одно бежало за другим.

[Gideon]

Пока можем сказать, что у нас грязные ботинки.

[Narrator]

Пасифика отмечает изгибы в своих заметках. Над кустами впереди видна покосившаяся крыша.

[Pacifica]

Тогда начнём с того, что не двигается.

[Gideon]

Не обещай за весь домик.

[Narrator]

Домик оказывается старой лесной сторожкой. Одна половина крыши просела, зато дверь ещё держится на обеих петлях.

[sfx ch2_wood_creak]

[Narrator]

Пасифика тянет ручку через рукав. Дерево поддаётся с коротким жалобным скрипом.

[Gideon]

Она была открыта.

[Pacifica]

Я заметила.

[Narrator]

Она заглядывает за косяк, затем делает шаг внутрь. Гидеон остаётся у порога, пока глаза привыкают к полумраку.

[Narrator]

В комнате пахнет мокрым деревом и пылью. Через разбитое окно на старый стол ложится узкая полоса света.

[Narrator]

На полках лежат пустые банки. Под столом свёрнута выцветшая бумага, похожая на карту местных троп.

[Narrator]

Пасифика обходит провалившуюся доску. Старая бумага под столом намокла по краям, и она не пытается развернуть её силой.

[Pacifica]

Если это карта, потом посмотрим. Пока не будем ломать.

[Gideon]

Домик оценит нашу сдержанность.

[Narrator]

Он остаётся на целой доске возле двери. Отсюда видно и окно, и большую часть пола.

[Pacifica]

Не похоже, чтобы сюда часто приходили люди.

[Gideon]

Пыль голосует за тебя.

[Narrator]

Пасифика останавливается у дальней стены. На досках идут четыре глубокие неровные борозды.

[expression Pacifica smile transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Вот. Помнишь рисунок возле описания когтей?

[Narrator]

Она торопливо открывает Дневник и подносит страницу к стене, не прикладывая бумагу к сырому дереву.

[Pacifica]

Очень похоже. И высота подходящая.

[Narrator]

Гидеон смотрит на верхний край царапин, затем на серое дерево внутри самой глубокой.

[expression Gideon suspicious transition .18]

[Gideon]

Они старые.

[Pacifica]

Оно могло бывать тут раньше.

[Gideon]

Могло. Но свежий след у двери не делает свежей всю стену.

[Narrator]

Пасифика убирает книгу на стол. Проводит лучом фонарика вдоль пола, не включая яркий режим.

[Narrator]

Между досками застряла шерсть: светлая, тёмная и короткие рыжие клочки.

[Pacifica]

Разные животные. Здесь они точно были.

[Gideon]

Да. Это уже можно записать без слова «наверное».

[Narrator]

За ножкой стола стоит металлическая миска. Пасифика замечает её только по маленькому отражению луча.

[Pacifica]

Вода.

[Narrator]

Она наклоняется, но Гидеон мягко стучит пальцем по краю стола, останавливая её руку.

[Gideon]

Сначала посмотри.

[Narrator]

На поверхности нет пыльной плёнки. Вокруг миски остались недавние брызги.

[Narrator]

Гидеон наклоняет голову к краю миски, ничего не касаясь. В тонком налёте на металле есть светлая полоска.

[Gideon]

Здесь недавно пили. Не просто стояла полная миска.

[Pacifica]

Значит, животные могли быть живы, когда были здесь.

[Gideon]

По крайней мере те, кто пил. Больше миска пока не обещала.

[Pacifica]

Её сюда недавно налили.

[Gideon]

Кто-то не хотел, чтобы животные оставались без воды.

[Narrator]

Пасифика обводит комнату фонариком ещё раз. Ищет пятна, шерсть на рваных краях, свежие кости.

[Narrator]

Ничего. Только земля у порога, пыль в углах и несколько клочков под столом.

[Pacifica]

Может, это не здесь происходило.

[Gideon]

Может. Но здесь не видно ни крови, ни остатков.

[Pacifica]

Ты всё время говоришь «может».

[Gideon]

У нас очень подходящее количество доказательств для этого слова.

[Narrator]

Она убирает фонарик чуть ниже. Дневник на столе открыт там, где рисунок выглядит особенно убедительно.

[Pacifica]

Следы. Царапины. Шерсть. Всё-таки многое совпадает.

[Gideon]

Слишком удобно, когда совпадает только то, что мы решили искать.

[Narrator]

Пасифика собирается закрыть книгу, но вместо этого переворачивает её обложкой вверх.

[expression Pacifica idle transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Ладно. Миска тоже улика. И отсутствие крови тоже.

[music stop fade .8]

[sfx branch_crack]

[wait .6]

[Narrator]

Снаружи сухо хрустит ветка. Оба замолкают.

[Narrator]

Гидеон переводит взгляд на дверной проём. Пасифика медленно поворачивает голову к окну.

[char showi Creature rightsecond scale .92]

[expression Creature silhouette transition 0]

[wait .4]

[char hidei Creature]

[Narrator]

Между выбитыми стёклами проходит тёмная высокая тень. Верх её силуэта цепляется за рисунок ветвей.

[Narrator]

Пасифика прижимает Дневник к себе. Она успевает увидеть лишь длинную руку и край согнутого плеча.

[expression Pacifica scared transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Там.

[expression Gideon idle transition .18]

Живы.

Жетон шумел?

Слышит.

Другое.

Мы были вдвоём.

Я пошёл с тобой сам.

Не собирай себе все ошибки.

Живы.

Его хозяин?

Тихо.

Знакомый голос?

Не люди.

Голос людей.

Внизу.

Мы пойдём вместе. Ты останься здесь с животными.

Вернёмся. И решим, как вывести их домой.

Она не добавляет обещания, что всё будет хорошо. Проверяет застёжку рюкзака и ждёт Гидеона.

Вот это уже похоже на расследование.

Мы выбрали самую большую лапу, потому что уже искали самого большого монстра.

Большие улики. Удобно заметить.

[when monster Wendigo][Pacifica]We need to stop looking for proof of a wendigo. First we look at what's actually there.

[when monster Werewolf][Pacifica]We need to stop looking for proof of a werewolf. First we look at what's actually there.

A reasonable plan. I can't even spoil it with a comment.

One more rule. If I decide who's guilty too quickly, tell me plainly.

[Gideon]

I think I did yesterday.

[Pacifica]

Today say it before I start arguing.

[Gideon]

I'll have to be very quick.

[Narrator]

She marks the fence and the old road on the napkin. Between them she leaves a blank space instead of a big, frightening silhouette.

[Pacifica]

That's a question for now. It can stay a question.

[Gideon]

Our plan has luggage now.

[Pacifica]

Water. A flashlight. And somewhere for the journal, so I don't have to carry it under my arm.

[Gideon]

Not a single ancient cursed object?

[Pacifica]

The bottle's from the kitchen. If it's cursed, it's being subtle.

[Narrator]

She doesn't take the flashlight out in daylight. She just checks the zip and turns toward the damaged fence first.

[Narrator]

From here, yesterday's trail seems shorter. Without an expected attack, the bushes take up an ordinary amount of space.

[Pacifica]

Watch your step. Yesterday we walked right along the edge.

[Gideon]

You walked. I was trying not to step on your heels.

[Narrator]

She is about to answer, but stops in front of a patch of damp soil.

[Narrator]

A pine needle lies inside a large impression. Water has collected along its uneven edge.

[Narrator]

She puts her toe beside it, leaving a gap. The print is noticeably bigger, but the impression isn't particularly deep.

[Pacifica]

If it's big, why didn't it press down harder?

[Gideon]

The ground might have been drier. Or it might be lighter than it looks.

[Narrator]

Pacifica writes down both explanations. She doesn't put a tick beside either one.

[Pacifica]

Like yesterday's. There's another one beside the root.

[Narrator]

She crouches without touching the print. Gideon walks around her on the dry side.

[Gideon]

And these.

[camera zoom 1.035 duration .8]

Between two large prints runs a line of much smaller ones. They nearly disappear in the flattened grass.

[Pacifica]

A dog's?

[Gideon]

Maybe. Just don't decide by size.

[Narrator]

Pacifica follows the line with her eyes. The small tracks pass behind a bush; the large ones go around the other side.

[Pacifica]

It could have changed the way it walked.

[Gideon]

And the amount of ground between its feet.

[Narrator]

She looks again. The two lines continue, and neither turns into the other.

[expression Pacifica idle transition .18]

[Pacifica]

All right. Two different trails. Possibly two different creatures.

[Gideon]

Already better than one that shrinks for convenience.

[Narrator]

Yesterday she wanted to name what she'd found immediately. Today she opens a page for notes first.

[Narrator]

A thin twig lies across the prints near the bush. Picking it up would be awkward, so Pacifica carefully steps over it.

[Gideon]

[when monster Wendigo][Narrator]In the wendigo drawing, the weight seems to fall forward toward the long toes. Here the ground is pressed deeper at the back.

Similar size. Different weight distribution.

Pacifica steps away from the muddy strip and carefully parts the tall grass beside it.

[Pacifica]

Water.

Something drank here recently. The bowl wasn't just standing here full.

[Pacifica]

So the animals could have been alive when they were here.

[Gideon]

At least the ones that drank. The bowl hasn't promised us more than that.

[Pacifica]

Someone filled it recently.

[Gideon]

Someone didn't want the animals to go without water.

[Narrator]

Pacifica scans the room with the flashlight again. She looks for stains, fur on torn edges, fresh bones.

[Narrator]

Nothing. Just soil by the threshold, dust in the corners, and a few tufts beneath the table.

[Pacifica]

Maybe it didn't happen here.

[Gideon]

Maybe. But there is no blood or anything left behind here.

[Pacifica]

You keep saying “maybe.”

[Gideon]

We have exactly the right amount of evidence for that word.

[Narrator]

She lowers the flashlight a little. The journal lies open where the drawing looks especially convincing.

[Pacifica]

Tracks. Scratches. Fur. A lot of it still fits.

[Gideon]

It's too convenient when only the things we decided to look for seem to fit.

[Narrator]

Pacifica is about to close the book, but instead turns it face down.

[expression Pacifica idle transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Fine. The bowl counts as evidence too. So does the lack of blood.

[music stop fade .8]

[sfx branch_crack]

[wait .6]

[Narrator]

A dry branch cracks outside. Both fall silent.

[Narrator]

Gideon looks toward the doorway. Pacifica slowly turns her head toward the window.

[char showi Creature rightsecond scale .92]

[expression Creature silhouette transition 0]

[wait .4]

[char hidei Creature]

[Narrator]

A tall, dark shadow passes between the broken panes. Its upper outline catches among the shapes of the branches.

[Narrator]

Pacifica holds the journal against her. She catches only a long arm and the edge of a bent shoulder.

[expression Pacifica scared transition .18]

[Pacifica]

There.

[expression Gideon idle transition .18]

[Gideon]

I see it. Don't run straight under the window.

[Narrator]

Pacifica is already at the door, but stops at the threshold. Outside, only the leaves move again.

[Pacifica]

I'll go along the edge. Stay close.

[Gideon]

Better than just “I'm going.”

[Narrator]

They leave together. The tall figure disappears between the rocks down the slope.

[item hide]

[effect clear]

[fx clear]

[camera preset normal duration .8]

[BG change ch2_rock_hollow time 1.2]

[music stop fade .8]

[ambience forest_tension]

[char hidei Creature Predator Dog]

[char showi Gideon left scale 1]

[char showi Pacifica right flip left scale 1]

[expression Gideon idle transition 0]

[expression Pacifica smile transition 0]

[Narrator]

Behind the watch hut, the ground dips into a shallow, rocky hollow. Damp moss gleams between the boulders.

[Narrator]

Pacifica descends sideways, testing each foothold. Gideon stays slightly higher so he can see past her shoulder.

[Pacifica]

It's here. We're not losing it again.

[Gideon]

So far we've only lost the chance to introduce ourselves normally.

[char showi Creature center scale 1]

[expression Creature neutral transition .4]

[camera zoom 1.04 duration .8]

[Narrator]

The figure stands beside the far rock. The branches no longer hide all of it.

[Narrator]

It is taller than Pacifica, narrow through the shoulders and unnaturally long. Irregular shapes break its upper outline.

[Narrator]

But it doesn't charge them. One hand stays against its side; the other is held out, palm facing them.

[Narrator]

At arm's length, all of this would be much too big. Across the hollow, it merely looks very cautious.

[Narrator]

Pacifica notices that the way out is still clear behind her. The creature isn't trying to block it.

[Pacifica]

Don't get too far away.

[Gideon]

I'm here.

[Narrator]

The answer is short. Right now, it's enough that he hasn't started arguing.

[Narrator]

Pacifica tightens her grip on the flashlight. Knowing it is ordinary doesn't make her feel calmer.

[Pacifica]

Don't move.

[Narrator]

The creature lowers its head slightly. Gideon notices it is looking at the light, not her face.

[Gideon]

Move the beam away from its eyes.

[Pacifica]

I'm not going to—

[Creature]

No.

[Narrator]

The voice is low and uneven. The word comes slowly, as if each sound has to be selected separately.

[Narrator]

Pacifica freezes. Gideon merely stops looking at the flashlight.

[expression Pacifica surprised transition .18]

[Pacifica]

You... talk?

[Creature]

A little.

[Narrator]

It moves its free hand away from its face. Its fingers catch against one another for a moment, then open.

[expression Gideon idle transition .18]

[Gideon]

Then a short question. The missing animals. Do you have them?

[Narrator]

The creature looks at him. At the journal in Pacifica's hands. Back at him.

[Creature]

Alive.

[Pacifica]

We found a collar. And fur. Do you understand how that looks?

[Creature]

Not it.

[Gideon]

So someone else took them from their homes?

[Narrator]

The creature shakes its head too sharply. Pacifica steps back half a pace and catches her heel against a rock.

[Narrator]

It notices the movement. It steps the other way, giving her room.

[Creature]

Found.

[Pacifica]

Found them where?

[Narrator]

The long arm points deeper into the woods. Then the creature points at the ground near its feet.

[Creature]

After.

[Narrator]

Pacifica looks at Gideon. He doesn't answer for her, or nod to the creature.

[Gideon]

If they're alive, show us.

[Creature]

Quiet.

[Narrator]

This time it speaks faster. It turns toward the trees behind the hut and listens for a while.

[Pacifica]

Why quiet?

[Creature]

Other.

[Narrator]

Pacifica doesn't lower the flashlight completely, but she no longer aims it at the creature.

[expression Pacifica curious transition .18]

[Pacifica]

I'm not promising to believe you. We'll look at the animals.

[Narrator]

It moves toward a narrow gap between the boulders. It waits, leaving the path clear.

[Pacifica]

Don't disappear behind the trees. If you want to show us, we need to see you.

[Narrator]

The creature looks at the gap and steps back. Not toward them, but sideways, where they can see it better.

[Narrator]

Gideon checks the slope behind them. The way back is unchanged: two rocks, a dry root, the hut door above.

[Gideon]

If there are no dogs, we come back here.

[Pacifica]

I know the way back.

[Gideon]

I want to know that you know it too.

[Narrator]

Pacifica holds back the answer she was ready to give. Instead she points at the root they just walked around.

[Pacifica]

Then we take this side. It isn't slippery here.

[Gideon]

We stay together. If I stop, you stop too.

[Pacifica]

If I stop, you stop too.

[Gideon]

That hasn't been a problem so far.

[Narrator]

She gives a quick nod. Beyond the rocks, the air smells of wet soil, and for the first time that morning a dog whines.

[Narrator]

The trail ends beneath the huge roots of a fallen tree. Their tangle shelters a small clearing on three sides.

[Narrator]

Old boxes lined with cloth stand among the roots. Beside each is water in a bowl or a deep lid.

[char showi Dog leftsecond scale .75]

[Narrator]

A dog's head rises from the biggest box. The dog sees Pacifica, sniffs the air, and gets awkwardly to its feet.

[expression Pacifica surprised transition .18]

[Pacifica]

Buster?

[Narrator]

At the name, the dog turns his whole body toward her. He is alive, with muddy paws and intact ears.

[Narrator]

Pacifica crouches and offers the back of her hand. The dog cautiously touches it with his nose.

[Gideon]

Don't grab him straight away.

[Pacifica]

I'm not grabbing him. Hello. People are looking for you, you know.

[Narrator]

A cat moves behind the boxes. Another, ginger one watches from a root above. A small dog sleeps on a folded jacket.

[Narrator]

Pacifica slowly counts them. Gideon checks the gap: the animals can get out between two roots.

[Narrator]

A strip of sunlight falls through the roots. It shows individual hairs on the jacket, rather than a mysterious shadow.

[Pacifica]

Four. And they all have water.

[Gideon]

And they're all looking at us like strangers. Fair enough, really.

[Narrator]

Pacifica moves her backpack out of the gap. She has already unzipped it, but realises the extra rustling only frightens the small dog.

[Pacifica]

They aren't locked in.

[Gideon]

That doesn't mean they know where they are.

[Narrator]

Buster circles Pacifica and returns to his bowl. A smooth band of flattened fur runs around his neck.

[Narrator]

Dried mud clings near one front paw. Pacifica watches him put weight on it: he isn't limping.

[Pacifica]

You look better than your collar.

[Gideon]

Not a very high bar.

[Narrator]

The dog sneezes on her sleeve. Pacifica pulls back her elbow, then exhales — almost a laugh.

[Narrator]

A small, ordinary nuisance suddenly becomes the most convincing evidence of the day.

[Pacifica]

And the collar? Why is Buster no longer wearing it?

[Creature]

Rings.

[Narrator]

The creature brings two fingers together. The small movement resembles a little metal ring swinging.

[Gideon]

The tag made noise?

[Creature]

Hears.

[Pacifica]

Who hears it?

[Creature]

Other.

[Narrator]

It doesn't approach the animals while Pacifica sits beside them. It stands between the edge of the clearing and the trees.

[Gideon]

They were already in the woods? Not near the houses?

[Creature]

In woods. Then... here.

[Narrator]

The last word takes more effort. The creature points at the boxes, then at a low, dark trail beyond the roots.

[Pacifica]

You could have taken them back. People thought they were dead.

[Creature]

Not there.

[Pacifica]

And who gave you the right to decide for them?

[Narrator]

The creature doesn't answer. It only raises its head at a barely audible rustle in the leaves.

[Narrator]

Gideon crouches beside the next bowl. The water is clean; pieces of softened food lie nearby.

[Gideon]

The water and food are from you.

[Creature]

Need.

[Narrator]

Pacifica strokes Buster once between the ears and takes her hand away. The journal presses against her knee.

[expression Pacifica sad transition .18]

[Pacifica]

And I was already fitting the drawing to its scratches.

[Gideon]

We haven't hit anyone.

[Pacifica]

I know. But I was going to. At the hut it all looked so obvious.

[Narrator]

She looks at the flashlight. Her knuckles are still white from gripping it so tightly.

[Pacifica]

We would have come here with an answer ready. We wouldn't even have looked at the bowls.

[expression Gideon idle transition .18]

[Gideon]

There were two of us.

[Narrator]

He says it quietly, still looking at the ground beside the box.

[Gideon]

I chose to come with you.

[Gideon]

Don't collect every mistake for yourself.

[Narrator]

Pacifica looks up. Gideon nudges an empty lid aside with his shoe so nobody steps on it.

[expression Pacifica idle transition .18]

[Pacifica]

All right. Then we'll fix it together too.

[Gideon]

First we figure out exactly what.

[Narrator]

She closes the journal. She doesn't hide it; she simply makes room on her knee.

[Pacifica]

It is good that they have water. But taking animals and not bringing them back is still a problem.

[Narrator]

The creature looks from her to the dogs. Its shoulders stay tense.

[Creature]

Alive.

[Pacifica]

Yes. And they need to go home alive.

[Narrator]

Gideon is about to ask something when Buster stops drinking.

[Narrator]

The dog raises one ear. The ginger cat leaves its root and moves farther beneath the tree.

[music stop fade 1]

[sfx ch2_mimic_buster]

[Mimic]

Buster...

[Narrator]

The voice comes from the woods. An ordinary human voice, slightly muffled by the trees.

[expression Pacifica surprised transition .18]

[Pacifica]

His owner?

[Narrator]

She begins to stand. The creature extends an arm across the gap without touching her.

[Creature]

Quiet.

[Mimic]

Buster... home...

[Narrator]

The second “Buster” sounds exactly the same, down to the last pause. But “home” seems to finish too late.

[Narrator]

Gideon looks at the dog, not the gap. Buster takes a step toward the sound, then stops.

[Gideon]

A familiar voice?

[Creature]

Not people.

[Narrator]

It waits, listens, then adds two words, slowly and separately.

[Creature]

People's voice.

[Narrator]

Pacifica straightens without a sudden movement. This time her flashlight points at the ground.

[Pacifica]

So there is someone out there after all.

[expression Gideon idle transition .18]

[Gideon]

Something. Let's not promote it to human just for its diction.

[Narrator]

Nobody smiles. The sounds beyond the trees now seem too far apart.

[Pacifica]

Where was it? Show us the direction. Don't lead us around guessing.

[Narrator]

The creature points toward the lower trail. Water glints quietly between two stones.

[Creature]

Below.

[Gideon]

We'll go together. You stay here with the animals.

[Narrator]

It turns its head toward the woods and back. Then it moves away from the gap.

[Pacifica]

We'll come back. And decide how to get them home.

[Narrator]

She doesn't add a promise that everything will be fine. She checks her backpack's zip and waits for Gideon.

[Narrator]

They step onto the lower trail. The large and small tracks are in front of them again, now raising different questions.

[Narrator]

The path narrows just beyond the shelter. Pacifica holds a branch aside for Gideon, then follows him.

[Pacifica]

Just as far as the stream. We see where the voice came from, then come back.

[Gideon]

I'll remember this version of the plan.

[Narrator]

She starts to answer, then checks that the roots above the shelter entrance are still visible.

[Pacifica]

Maybe it called them out itself, and now it's blaming something else?

[Gideon]

Maybe. That's why I'm watching the ground instead of its honest eyes.

[Narrator]

A large print crosses a narrow trail ahead. Gideon crouches, holding back his sleeve.

[Pacifica]

Two sizes again.

[Gideon]

And an order. Look at the edge.

[Narrator]

The heavy foot has crushed half a small print. The small one runs underneath it, not across the top.

[Pacifica]

The big one came through later.

[Gideon]

At this spot, yes.

[Pacifica]

That still doesn't mean it wasn't hunting.

[Gideon]

It doesn't. I'm not giving it a good-behavior certificate.

[Narrator]

Pacifica crouches beside him. Up close, the impression looks much less like the journal drawing.

[Pacifica]

Yesterday we kept asking what it looked like.

[Gideon]

We should've asked what happened here.

[Narrator]

He opens his fingers one at a time, as though laying out things from different pockets.

[Gideon]

The fence broke outward. The dog got out by itself.

[Pacifica]

And there was hardly any blood by the fence.

[Gideon]

It didn't go where it was safer. It went toward someone calling.

[Pacifica]

We still don't know exactly how it called her.

[Gideon]

But we just heard it trying to do it again.

[Narrator]

No dogs or clattering metal bowls can be heard from the shelter now.

[Pacifica]

Buster wanted to follow the voice. Even after he noticed something was wrong.

[Gideon]

The collar came off later. At the shelter. Not at the fence.

[Pacifica]

So the collar in the clearing didn't prove there'd been an attack.

[Gideon]

Just that the dog stopped wearing it.

[Narrator]

Pacifica touches her backpack clasp, then moves her hand away. Even a small click feels unnecessary here.

[Pacifica]

And the little tracks were there before the big ones.

[Gideon]

At least these were. They head toward the houses, then away from them.

[Pacifica]

So the little one wasn't chasing the big one.

[Gideon]

It was first.

[Narrator]

She looks from the trampled earth to the forest, which has seemed like one solid wall all morning.

[Pacifica]

It wasn't catching up to the animals. It was leading them.

[Gideon]

And the big one found them afterward. If its story is true, it finally fits the tracks.

[Pacifica]

And it still could have left something out.

[Gideon]

It could. That's why we're taking the animals, not moving in under its tree.

[Narrator]

A pine needle lies at the edge of the print. Pacifica lifts it to check the impression's depth, then puts it back exactly where it was.

[Pacifica]

At least I can check this myself. Without promises or pictures.

[Gideon]

That sounds more like an investigation.

[Narrator]

She doesn't answer with a jab. She simply stands and picks the next patch where the ground is visible.

[Pacifica]

We picked the biggest footprint because we were already looking for the biggest monster.

[Gideon]

Big clues. Easy to spot.

[Pacifica]

Don't act like you never believed it for a second.

[Gideon]

I believed it enough to come here two days in a row.

[Narrator]

She gives a brief nod. Gideon stands and brushes off his knee without waiting for an answer.

[ambience ch2_stream]

[BG change ch1_tracks time 1]

[Narrator]

Water glints between the stones ahead. The two sets of prints separate before reaching the bank.

[Pacifica]

The big one went straight through the water.

[Gideon]

And the little one looked for dry stones.

[Narrator]

They follow the bank. Each time, Pacifica tests a stone with her toe before putting her weight on it.

[Pacifica]

Now I understand why nobody takes walks here.

[Gideon]

Bad reviews. Difficult parking.

[Narrator]

A short, hoarse bark comes from behind a fallen tree.

[Narrator]

A few seconds later it repeats. With the same break in the middle.

[Pacifica]

Hear that?

[Gideon]

The same cough. Even dogs usually try for more variety.

[Narrator]

Pacifica takes her flashlight. Her fingers rest on the switch, but she leaves it off.

[BG change ch2_drainage_entrance time 1.2]

[ambience ch2_stream]

[camera zoom 1.04 duration .9]

[Narrator]

A concrete arch appears below the slope. Roots grip its rim, and a wet stripe darkens its base.

[Pacifica]

An old drain. Or a maintenance passage.

[Gideon]

I hope the workers had another entrance.

[Narrator]

The small prints become clearer near the arch. They skirt the wet earth right along the wall.

[music stop fade .8]

[sfx ch2_mimic_pacifica]

[Mimic]

Gideon?

[Narrator]

Pacifica goes still. Her mouth is closed. Her flashlight points at the ground.

[Mimic]

Gideon, come here.

[Narrator]

The voice is close. Only the last word lasts a little too long, as though waiting for permission to end.

[Pacifica]

I'm here.

[Gideon]

Yes. That's the problem.

[Narrator]

He watches her until he is certain she is looking back at him.

[Gideon]

If you hear me up ahead again, check where the real one is first.

[Pacifica]

I will. You check too.

[Narrator]

She switches on the flashlight and leads the way down to the arch. This time, slowly enough for him to stay beside her.

We won't.
